Rugged handheld / 6.5″ / Windows 11 Pro

Tuga WH6

Windows in your pocket.

£799 Includes VAT. Free UK delivery

The WH6 puts full Windows 11 Pro in your pocket. An Intel N100, 16GB of RAM and a 512GB SSD mean you can run the legacy Windows software your industry never moved off, reach network drives, and manage field data without compromise. Sealed to IP67 and drop tested to MIL-STD-810H, with a 10000mAh battery and 4G LTE. A barcode scanner variant is available for warehouse and logistics work, and a charging dock is sold separately for desk use.
